st: Smash the wave! Luffy and zoro use the strongest combo!
d: Zoro and Luffy go head-to-head with Mother Nature, and Sanji’s rescue mission is bolstered by Franky’s allegiance – and the arrival of the mysterious Sniper King!

st: A mysterious man appears?! His name is sniper king!
d: Sniper King, a mysterious warrior from the island of snipers, lends a hand as Franky and Sanji try to fight their way to Robin.

st: Showdown between cooks! Sanji vs. Ramen kenpo!
d: Sanji mixes it up with a deranged cook, Franky dukes it out with the newest member of CP9, and the Sniper King gets creative in his attempt to reach Robin!

st: Rooftop duel! Franky vs. Nero!
d: Franky and Sanji continue to battle the thugs of CP9. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the gang find themselves headed for a collision that could spell doom for everyone!

st: Clash! Demon-slasher zoro vs. Ship-slasher t-bone!
d: Zoro faces a fellow master of the blade, Sanji looks to end his fight against a rampaging ramen master, and Franky finally lands a big blow against his CP9 foe!

st: Scramble over robin! A cunning plan by sniper king!
d: The Sniper King hatches a daring escape plan, but the assassins of CP9 are more powerful than our heroes ever imagined. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang run into a very familiar frog!

st: The judicial island! Full view of enies lobby!
d: As their train approaches Enies Lobby, Franky’s kind words cut through Robin’s cold exterior. Luffy’s train is thrown off course, but the group gains a powerful new ally!

st: Landing operations start! Charge in, straw hats!
d: The Straw Hats hatch a plan to rescue Robin, but as usual, Luffy can’t wait to find a fight. Will his impulsive attack derail their mission?

st: Luffy cuts through! Big showdown on the judicial island!
d: Luffy manages to reach the main island, but the Franky Family’s assault is stopped short by a couple of angry giants!

st: Battle against giants! Open the second gate!
d: Luffy makes short work of a few hundred marines, the Franky Family takes down a giant, and the assassins of CP9 report back to Spandam!

st: Find a way out! Rocketman takes flight!
d: Zoro’s quick thinking – and a little help from a giant frog – sends the sea train soaring into the sky on a collision course with armed guards and their canine companions!

st: Catch up with luffy! The straw hats' all-out battle
d: Nami electrocutes the enemy with a Clima Tact attack, but the bad guys have the Straw Hats surrounded until the Franky Family shows up with a couple of sea monsters!

st: Robin betrayed! The motive of the world government!
d: Zoro, Sanji, Nami, and Chopper try to catch up with their captain, Soge King is nowhere to be found, and Luffy runs head first into a battle with Blueno!

st: Give robin back! Luffy vs. Blueno!
d: Luffy shows off his new strength in a brawl with Blueno, Soge King befriends a giant, and a hulking sea beast makes the ultimate sacrifice.

st: Don't stop! Hoist the counterattack signal!
d: While Luffy continues his battle with Blueno, Soge King’s giant companions make their presence felt, and the assassins of CP9 experiment with Devil Fruits!

st: Almost to luffy! Gather at the courthouse plaza!
d: A blind Kingbull fights with his last breath to get the Straw Hats one step closer to their captain. Luffy kick his body into second gear to protect his friends from dangerous foes!

st: Everything is to protect my friends! Second gear activated!
d: Luffy batters a baffled Blueno with his powerful new fighting style, and the cowardly Spandam begins to panic at the sound of the Straw Hats approaching!

st: Give us your answer, robin! The straw hats' outcry!
d: Luffy and his crew are finally reunited and ready to rescue Robin, but the raven-haired beauty remains reluctant to rejoin her former mates despite Franky’s urging.

st: Robin's past! The girl who was called a devil!
d: Flash back to Robin’s days as a young girl, her dangerous pursuit of forbidden knowledge, and her encounter with a friendly giant.

st: Fated mother and daughter! The mother's name is olvia!
d: Robin’s flashback continues with the heartbreaking arrival of her mother – and the government’s cruel and brutal invasion of a peaceful island!

st: The tragedy of ohara! The terror of the buster call!
d: Professor Clover reveals a startling and sinister theory about the World Government, Robin reunites with her mother, and a giant joins the fight!

st: Say you want to live! We are your friends!
d: The painful story of Ohara – and Robin’s younger years – draws to a tragic close. Luffy declares war on the World Government, and Robin finally changes her tune!

st: Jump towards the falls! Luffy's feelings!
d: The Straw Hats are ready to begin the fight for Robin, but first, Luffy flashes back to memories of his childhood – and the man who made him want to become a pirate!

st: The ways of men! Zoro's techniques, usopp's dream!
d: Zoro remembers the first time he met Luffy, and Usopp recalls the events that led him to join the Straw Hats!

st: A bond of friendship woven by tears! Nami's world map!
d: Nami’s heartbreaking past – and Luffy’s epic battle with Arlong – are recalled in this flashback to the early days of the Straw Hats!

st: Parting builds a man's character! Sanji and chopper!
d: A flashback sheds light on how Sanji came to join the crew, and Chopper’s backstory is revealed through memories of a visit to a snow-covered island!

st: Everything is for her friends! Robin in the darkness!
d: A flashback reveals Robin’s motives for cooperating with CP9, Nami’s shocking discovery about the archaeologist’s past, and Luffy’s determination to save his friend!

st: I'm not gonna hand over the blueprints! Franky's decision!
d: Franky stands up to Spandam by destroying what the madman desires most, and the sound of the sea train spurs the Straw Hats to make a daring leap of faith!

st: Obtain the five keys! The straw hat pirates vs. Cp9!
d: Luffy races to rescue Robin while the rest of the Straw Hats set off in search of the five keys needed to unlock the archaeologist!

st: Devil fruit powers! Kaku and jabra transform!
d: While Usopp and Zoro go head-to-head with a couple of animal assassins, Sanji teaches the most beautiful member of CP9 the secrets of making good tea!

st: I won't kick even if it costs me my life! Sanji's chivalry!
d: Luffy runs into trouble trying to sail his way to Robin, Usopp and Zoro end up handcuffed together, and Sanji’s inability to kick a women may lead to serious injury!

st: Fukurou's miscalculation! My cola is the water of life!
d: Chimney and Gombe show Luffy the secret passage that leads to Robin, and Franky puts on a display of raw punching power thanks to a few bottles of cola!

st: Zoro busts out a new technique! The sword's name is sniper king?
d: While Franky’s brawl spills into the ocean, Usopp and Sanji attempt to overcome their handcuffs by outsmarting their opponents!
